authorship.method: Direct model authorship from approved Russian, no pivot target, external translator/API/model or wording-generating script. Assembly copies authored literals only.

terminology_decisions.Guests: Capitalized Wageni/Mgeni distinct from lowercase ordinary guests.
terminology_decisions.committee: Full native Kamati ya Hali za Dharura, Russian and official English literals preserved in126.
terminology_decisions.psychics: Wenye uwezo wa hisia za ziada, broad extrasensory service.
terminology_decisions.spirits: Roho ya Mgeni versus Roho ya Marehemu, both distinct from Guest creatures and attributed to service.
terminology_decisions.mushrooms: Nchi ya Uyoga, Mkusanya uyoga, Miseliamu, Tamasha la Uyoga, Kitabu cha Tabasamu; clues vidokezo.
terminology_decisions.gender: Swahili personal pronouns are sex-neutral; explicit known sex maintained only where source establishes it. Source Russian gender evidence quotes retained, unknown identities remain unknown; cat and Death source grammatical forms retained in explanation.
terminology_decisions.brands: Native Latin transliteration Enerzheka/Bober Cherni/Margoro; For Rest/AURACAM/CR Channel exact.
terminology_decisions.actions: Mwache ends inspection, never implies expulsion; linked action labels exact.
terminology_decisions.literals: Codes, numeric protocols, source IDs and sprite tags exact.
